comments.author: RangerB
comments.body: Re-charting this landing zone opens the possibility of obtaining Geography maps for Lake Erie, Lake Huron, and Lake Ontario.

comments.author: Pinnacle
comments.body: What do I need to do to be able to chart this Landing Zone?

comments.author: CA-RvZ
comments.body: You need to chart at least 100 other landing points in order to chart this one, that's including West Siberian Plain, Caucasus, The Sahara, Zambezi River Midstream, Paraguay River Upstream, & Amazon Inland. Once you reach that amount of charting, Professor will give you the task to chart it, along with The Rocky Mountains landing.
